justification: Both show relief carving with human figures and decorative motifs organized in bands, but that is about as generic as such a correspondence can be: A depicts a naturalistic profile procession of attendants leading a two-humped camel along a horizontal frieze bounded by rosette borders, while B depicts a vertical shaft covered in dense, frontal, stacked cartouche-like panels of interlaced ornament with masklike faces. The specific subjects (a led pack animal in profile versus stacked frontal emblematic panels) and the compositional axis (horizontal register versus vertical column) share nothing distinctive; the seated figure in B is a modern onlooker outside the carving.
